The Vibe

Street food energy, café calm.

Street 1 Café sits where a buzzing street-food cart meets a slow Sunday brunch table. By day it's sun through the trees, red umbrellas, and the clatter of a busy pass. By night, string lights and paper balloon lanterns turn the same courtyard into something a little more sparkly and a lot more romantic.

The menu leans into that same push and pull — hearty desi breakfasts next to skillet brownies, char-grilled steaks next to iced lattes. Nothing here is trying too hard. It's just really, really good at being exactly what you're craving.

Behind the Counter

Every cup, poured with intention.

There's a small ritual to every cup that leaves the machine — a slow pull, steamed milk folded in soft circles, and a heart drawn in foam right before it reaches your table.

01

Beans ground fresh, espresso pulled slow for a full-bodied shot.

02

Milk steamed to silk, folded in — never rushed, never scorched.

03

A little latte art on top, because the small things matter here.

crafted daily, one cup at a time
